Simplify: C= C(Ph)C1CCC(C(OH)C(F)(F)F)C1? Actually the cyclobutane: C1CC[C@@]1(OH)C(F)(F)F. So final SMILES: C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(OH)C(F)(F)F? Need correct. Let's generate: "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(OH)C(F)(F)F". But need double bond: "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(OH)C(F)(F)F". Use "C= C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(OH)C(F)(F)F". Might be okay.
